art_note: Clean studio product shots with high-end close-ups, though some lifestyle composites detract from the luxury standard.
desc_en: Flip-flops designed for the summer season, combining functionality and design. They feature a cushioned insole for enhanced comfort and an easy slip-on construction. The aesthetic includes distinctive graphic details and a textured sole that provides contrast. A versatile piece for days of relaxation, crafted with selected materials for daily wear.
desc_es: Chanclas diseñadas para el periodo estival, combinando funcionalidad y diseño. Incorporan una plantilla acolchada para mayor confort y un sistema de sujeción sencillo de poner. Su estética incluye detalles gráficos distintivos y una suela texturizada que aporta contraste. Una pieza versátil para los días de descanso, confeccionada con materiales seleccionados para el uso diario.
